bounded_contexts.name: cloud-data
bounded_contexts.description: Code-backed Cloud Data local foundation for provider-neutral managed data-service metadata, data-service admission, and Postgres/Citus tenant+cell guardrail invariants. No live Postgres/Citus cluster, REST server, SDK, worker, backup restore drill, WAL archiving, migration executor, measured SLO, active-active DR, sharding automation, OpenTofu plan/apply, or audit-chain persistence is claimed by CS-CLOUD-DATA-001.

contracts.contract_status: cloud/cloud-data OpenAPI scaffold has intentionally empty paths; design AsyncAPI/proto contracts are metadata-only review evidence and do not prove runtime broker/gRPC service readiness

slo_exemption.rationale: No current measured runtime SLI exists for this foundation, retired, or local-scaffold service; the manifest must not claim production or hyperscaler-ready SLO coverage until an OpenSLO file lands.

ips.title: Postgres/Citus tenant-cell partitioning, migration/backup gate foundation, and Cloud Data manifest truth-down

hyperscaler_inv_coverage.circuit_breaker: not_claimed_cs_cloud_data_001: no implemented Cloud Data runtime circuit-breaker/bulkhead or database proxy evidence
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.tenant_rate_limit: not_claimed_cs_cloud_data_001: no implemented per-tenant Cloud Data API quota/rate-limit enforcement
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.golden_signals: not_claimed_cs_cloud_data_001: no implemented metrics/OpenSLO/golden-signal emission evidence
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.error_budget_burn: not_claimed_cs_cloud_data_001: SLO list is empty because no measured Cloud Data SLI or burn-rate rule is implemented yet

audit_chain.non_claim: CS-CLOUD-DATA-001 records a multispectrum evidence bundle and audit-chain row only; it does not implement Cloud Data runtime audit emission, Merkle sealing, or persistence.

secrets_substrate.non_claim: No raw database password, provider credential, KMS material, WAL archive credential, restore token, or tenant payload is introduced or consumed by this local foundation.

mesh_layering.non_claim: No live Cloud Data pod, service mesh policy, database proxy, or network path is deployed by CS-CLOUD-DATA-001.

data_isolation.non_claim: Rust guardrails validate intended tenant/cell/RLS/Citus metadata only. They do not create tables, policies, roles, schemas, shards, or Citus distributed tables in a live database.

migration_gate.non_claim: No migration runner, online DDL executor, Citus rebalance, or cutover tool is implemented by CS-CLOUD-DATA-001.

backup_gate.non_claim: No live WAL archiving, base backup, object-store upload, restore drill, checksum, or PITR replay is executed by CS-CLOUD-DATA-001.

data_classification: PUBLIC metadata, INTERNAL_ONLY control-plane metadata, AUDIT evidence; no tenant payload processing is implemented by this ChangeSet

capacity_model.notes: CS-CLOUD-DATA-001 is metadata/domain/kernel validation only. Runtime database clusters, connections, query paths, capacity telemetry, autoscaling, and SLOs remain explicit non-claims.

sharding_automation.non_claim: No autosharding, Citus rebalance, hot split, cold merge, tenant migration, or audit-chain persistence is implemented by CS-CLOUD-DATA-001.

dr.non_claim: No live Cloud Data replication, warm standby, cross-region failover, restore drill, or DR measurement evidence is implemented by CS-CLOUD-DATA-001.

pod_runtime_tier_justification: Cloud Data is intended Tier-1 substrate because later runtime pods will touch tenant data. CS-CLOUD-DATA-001 has no runtime pod deployment; tier is retained as intended future isolation class only.

tenant_version_pinning.non_claim: The OpenAPI file has no paths; no tenant-facing API version pinning is implemented by CS-CLOUD-DATA-001.

explicit_non_claims: No live Postgres, Citus, pgvector, Valkey, Kafka, ClickHouse, Iceberg, Cassandra, Milvus, or Temporal service is provisioned.

No database schemas, roles, RLS policies, Citus distributed tables, shards, pgbouncer pools, migrations, WAL archives, backups, restores, DR drills, REST server, SDK, worker, OpenTofu plan/apply, provider-live smoke, measured SLO, capacity telemetry, or audit-chain persistence is implemented.
Legacy Markdown benchmark/parity/runbook files under cloud/cloud-data remain planning/prose and are not readiness evidence for CS-CLOUD-DATA-001.
